puzzles.title: Welcome Check-In
puzzles.storyText: Buddy is nervous for his first visit. Guide him straight to the exam table.
puzzles.goalText: Move Buddy to the exam table tile.

hintRules.hint: Make sure the last block lands Buddy on the exam table.
If Buddy bumps into something, add a turn before the move.

puzzles.title: Scale Side Step
puzzles.storyText: The hallway has carts in the way. Steer Bella around them to the scale.
puzzles.goalText: Turn before the obstacle and reach the scale tile.

hintRules.hint: Use a turn before walking into the carts.
Bella must end on the glowing scale tile.

puzzles.title: Zigzag Prep
puzzles.storyText: Milo needs to zigzag between supply crates. Face the right direction before walking.
puzzles.goalText: Reach the prep mat at the top of the hallway.

hintRules.hint: Face north again before making the final walk.
Supply crates block the path marked with # symbols.

puzzles.title: Treat Fetch
puzzles.storyText: Pick up a calming treat before meeting Noodle at the cushion.
puzzles.goalText: Collect the treat and reach Noodle.

hintRules.hint: Pick up the treat before heading to the cushion.
Use turns to snake through the storage racks.

puzzles.title: Comfort Delivery
puzzles.storyText: Pip the puppy calms down when you hand over a toy and treat.
puzzles.goalText: Grab the treat and deliver it at Pip’s bed.

hintRules.hint: Use the Give Treat block once you reach Pip.
Pip only counts as helped if you stop on the bed tile.

puzzles.title: Hallway Hustle
puzzles.storyText: The therapy dog Dash needs to jog down a long hallway. Use a loop to save blocks.
puzzles.goalText: Reach the treadmill at the far end using Repeat blocks.

hintRules.hint: Set the Repeat count high enough to reach the treadmill.
You must include the Repeat block or you will run out of moves.

puzzles.title: Brush Brigade
puzzles.storyText: Sprinkles rolled in mud. Brush her three times after reaching the grooming mat.
puzzles.goalText: Arrive at the mat and brush the pet three times (loop recommended).

hintRules.hint: Stop by the brush cart before brushing Sprinkles.
Make sure you brush three times—use Repeat to save blocks.

puzzles.title: Sanitation Sweep
puzzles.storyText: Three exam stations must be cleaned. Loop through each square.
puzzles.goalText: Walk the square path and run Clean Station at each stop.

hintRules.hint: Plan a loop that covers all four stations.
Clean Station must run at each stop, not just once.

puzzles.title: Snack Circuit
puzzles.storyText: Deliver snacks to three crates. Repeat the same pattern.
puzzles.goalText: Use Repeat Sequence to visit each crate and drop a treat.

hintRules.hint: Give a treat at every crate using the same repeated pattern.
Load up on treats before looping through crates.

puzzles.title: Vitals Circuit
puzzles.storyText: Check vitals at each colored station before returning to the mentor.
puzzles.goalText: Loop around the ring and run Check Vitals at every station.

hintRules.hint: Run Check Vitals at every colored station.
Stay inside the exam ring as you loop.

puzzles.title: Sniffle Sort
puzzles.storyText: Clover might have sniffles. Use an If block to give medicine only when needed.
puzzles.goalText: Diagnose Clover and administer medicine if sniffles are present.

hintRules.hint: Wrap the medicine block inside an If that checks for sniffles.
Swing by the medication cart before treating Clover.

puzzles.title: Itch Patrol
puzzles.storyText: Luna might be itchy or perfectly fine. Use If/Else to choose between ointment and a treat.

hintRules.hint: Use If/Else so Luna gets ointment when itchy and a treat otherwise.
Grab ointment from the shelf before treating Luna.

puzzles.title: Splint Station
puzzles.storyText: Rex limped in with an injured paw. Apply a bandage only after checking vitals.
puzzles.goalText: Sequence a vitals check followed by a bandage application.

hintRules.hint: Check vitals before you apply the bandage.
Stop at the bandage cart on the way.

puzzles.title: Symptom Sweep
puzzles.storyText: Rotate through rooms and treat whichever symptom you observe. Loop until all are resolved.
puzzles.goalText: Use Repeat Until with condition checks to clear each symptom.

hintRules.hint: Ensure the Repeat Until condition eventually becomes true by removing each symptom.
Check for each symptom before applying the matching treatment.

puzzles.title: Pharmacy Protocol
puzzles.storyText: Multiple pets queue up. Dispense medicine, ointment, or treats depending on their chart.
puzzles.goalText: Handle three chart entries using nested logic.

hintRules.hint: Each queue tile expects a different treatment. Use branches to decide.
Restock before visiting each queue tile.

puzzles.title: Night Watch
puzzles.storyText: During night rounds you must move quietly, pausing between stations and reacting to random symptoms.
puzzles.goalText: Traverse every ward tile, pausing briefly, and resolve symptoms as they appear.

hintRules.hint: Pause briefly at each ward tile using the Pause block.
Remember to treat the itch before finishing rounds.

puzzles.title: Grand Rounds
puzzles.storyText: Final challenge! Multiple pets with different needs await. Combine loops, logic, and treatments.
puzzles.goalText: Resolve every symptom, deliver items, and finish at the celebration mat.

hintRules.hint: Finish on the celebration mat after resolving every symptom.
Remember the different treatment blocks: ointment for itchy, medicine for sniffles, bandage for injuries.
Use clear exit conditions so loops eventually stop.
